evidenceRule: Source/CI/compile evidence never upgrades a live-game gate to passed. Direct attended evidence is tied to an exact artifact under docs/test-runs/.

gates.remaining: Keep the canonical goal/architecture set synchronized only when the user changes product intent; retired RealPass specifications are not parallel sources of truth.
Apply the policy per feature: investigate supported Cyberpunk/CDPR/REDmod capability before accepting a community workaround, and preserve evidence when a fallback remains.
Preserve explicit-root/fail-closed deployment behavior. Recognition/deployment must not be re-listed as unknown unless a supported game/tool version changes.

Executing gameplay/presentation remains Biology-owned and source-mod runtime remains blocked. Continue reducing temporary generic dependency depth only when current consumers can be replaced without increasing fragility.

Keep the public semantic surface minimal: whole-mod activation boundary plus the E3 presentation preference where practical. Provider choice remains replaceable; no managed feature ledger or per-subsystem balance controls.
Offline invariants do not establish native timing, calibration, persistence, or gameplay feel.

Apply the deny/ownership policy to every candidate and keep it synchronized with accepted dependencies and the player uninstaller.

Current candidate directly retains redscript and temporarily retains Mod Settings, ArchiveXL and RED4ext. Re-audit exact redistribution payload/notices before public release and remove the temporary chain when its accepted consumer disappears. TweakXL, Codeware and Input Loader remain excluded.

A release-shaped Biology package now builds, exact-compiles, installs, and deploys through official REDmod. Public release remains gated by current runtime/UI/presentation/disable/uninstall and broader gameplay acceptance.
Prove that REDlauncher Enable mods OFF yields Biology-inactive vanilla behavior across REDmod and every supplemental script/framework route without requiring uninstall.

Implement and directly validate self-contained Uninstall Biology.exe: manifest/hash-driven removal, changed/ambiguous-file refusal, shared-root protection, save preservation, settings preserved by default, and REDmod-state refresh.

Attend body/injury/pain state across save/reload, verify version/update ownership behavior, and close hard-uninstall acceptance through #44. Steam reinstall is exceptional clean-room/recovery, not normal Biology removal.
Test critical Phantom Liberty/base-game sequences, authored combat/immortality exceptions, special equipment states, menus and scanner flows with the integrated Biology candidate.
Measure live script latency/performance under ordinary exploration, combat, menu use, time progression, and NPC load after functional integration stabilizes.
Keep cloud CI reproducible from public source. It remains Tier 1 evidence and never substitutes for exact local compile or attended gameplay.
